locality_sector.pooling: episode x target_hour x 7 localities x 5 sectors over absolute cell residuals and squared cell residuals

system_total.pooling: episode x target_hour after system aggregation
system_total.residual: sum the 35 signed locality-sector residuals before absolute value or squaring

limitations: Synthetic demand traces do not establish real-world forecast accuracy.
Sensitivity covers only one-factor-at-a-time ±25% demand-allocation perturbations.
Sensitivity intervals are descriptive, pointwise 95%, and unadjusted for multiple comparisons; they do not support family-wide significance claims.

Seeds are disjoint only from every documented training, validation, and model-selection seed in data/model/training-provenance.yaml. The holdout was not preregistered or independently custodied and cannot rule out undocumented activity.
No behavior-cloning-only ablation was run, so this comparison cannot isolate the incremental effect of PPO fine-tuning.

seed_separation.claim_scope: Documented-seed-disjoint means disjoint from every training, validation, and model-selection seed documented in data/model/training-provenance.yaml; it does not claim knowledge of undocumented external activity.
